issues.legal_issue: A party that submits to a tribunal’s remand without objecting to it cannot later rely on the alleged invalidity of the remand to obtain supervisory relief setting aside the findings made after remand.
material_facts: In a land-ceiling proceeding, the landholder appealed the initial determination, and the State argued that additional land had been omitted from the calculation.
The appellate tribunal remanded the matter for a fresh determination, although the State had filed no cross-objection to the initial findings.
The landholder submitted to the remand and did not challenge its validity before the tribunal conducting the fresh inquiry or in the ensuing appeal.
On remand, the tribunal included additional land in the holding and determined a larger surplus; the appellate tribunal affirmed that determination.
The High Court later set aside the post-remand orders on the ground that the remand exceeded the appellate tribunal’s jurisdiction.
issues.conclusion: The High Court’s judgment was set aside, and the remand order and the post-remand determination, as affirmed on appeal, were restored.
issues.legal_principle: A party that submits to a remand without objecting to it waives the right to challenge the remand later; in these circumstances, supervisory jurisdiction under Article 227 of the Constitution did not justify setting aside the post-remand findings. The underlying land-ceiling determination concerned Section 12 of the Maharashtra Agricultural Lands (Ceiling on Holdings) Act, 1961. No earlier cases were relied on.

rule.if: supervisory_challenge_after_remand and party_submitted_to_remand and party_did_not_later_challenge_remand and post_remand_decision_affirmed

predicates.supervisory_challenge_after_remand: A party sought supervisory review of a tribunal’s findings made after the matter had been remanded.
predicates.party_submitted_to_remand: The party accepted and proceeded under the remand without objecting to it.
predicates.party_did_not_later_challenge_remand: The party did not challenge the validity of the remand before the tribunal conducting the fresh inquiry or in the ensuing appeal.
predicates.post_remand_decision_affirmed: An appellate tribunal affirmed the findings made after remand.

issues.definition: When a party seeks supervisory review of findings made after remand, submitted to the remand, did not later challenge it, and the post-remand decision was affirmed on appeal, the post-remand orders remain in force.
